competing_explanations.hypothesis: Late participation after relative acceleration pays a poor entry price and leaves first-day damage before a positive-profit exit can act
competing_explanations.discriminator: Actual entry-day PnL and candidate-entry-D acceleration, retaining all plans and unfilled orders; policy must gate D intent before E rather than remove realized losing fills

competing_explanations.hypothesis: Using relative acceleration only when P>0 omits material already-held losing states, which may need early exit too
competing_explanations.discriminator: Frozen Z threshold evaluated on actual held P<=0 states; compare complete policy with and without P domain, not a later observed return filter

competing_explanations.hypothesis: Support exit plus reservation misses recovery and later resumes at a higher price
competing_explanations.discriminator: Reconstruct Sep/Oct actual D actions and reservation, missed underlying days and reentry price; cannot infer policy-event causal signal

competing_explanations.hypothesis: Successive losing cycles signal poor participation regime beyond one-cycle rules
competing_explanations.discriminator: Read-only prior-rule inventory and closed-cycle loss chains; do not add a loss-streak rule to initial account design without discrimination

competing_explanations.hypothesis: Apparent same-year effects arise from earlier holdings or capital/lot path rather than a new same-year signal
competing_explanations.discriminator: Own-opening wealth, actual entry/exit/carry and all other years; no annual reset

initial_work: Read-only loss bridge/cycle inventory and prior-rule review. No new policy accounts or parameter search until material evidence and reviewed design fixed.
policy_skeleton_under_review: If supported by attribution, inherited Z>2 applied at entry-intent versus expanded held-exit domain in a fixed2x2; keep ENTRY_GRACE and all thresholds unchanged. Not yet final execution design.
evidence_boundary: D-close known features only; next execution E includes constraints/fees/limits; no future peaks, realized-sign gating or year/date-specific interventions
economic_scope: All authorized complete2020-25 years,2026 original technical tail only, own annual opening and full continuous accounts
hard_goals: Original yearly return/drawdown and original full-window frequency unchanged; other-year harm, uncertainty and concentration diagnostics are report-only
